image_description: A high-angle shot of a bathroom setting featuring a roll of white toilet paper mounted on a clear plastic dispenser. The roll is partially unspooled, with loose sheets draping over the side and resting on a speckled brown floor or surface below. A second, crumpled mass of toilet paper lies on the floor to the left.
